description: List products with optional search, pagination, and location filter.

access_token.description: CRM access token (optional — your connected CRM is used when omitted)

limit.description: Max number of products to return

locationId.description: Location ID to list products for

location_id.description: CRM sub-account location ID (optional — defaults to your connected location)

offset.description: Number of products to skip for pagination

search.description: Search query to filter products by name

name: crm_list_products
